## Use cases

The library lists 72 practical SI jobs for small teams and community organizations. They are illustrations of what is possible, not reports of client results. A person still approves anything that sends, pays, orders, or posts.

- Library: https://gemmisi.com/use-cases/
- Morning inbox triage into labeled queues: https://gemmisi.com/use-cases/inbox-triage/
- Follow-ups for quotes and estimates that went quiet: https://gemmisi.com/use-cases/quote-follow-ups/
- Supplier invoices from email into draft bills: https://gemmisi.com/use-cases/invoice-intake-to-draft-bills/
- A one-page weekly snapshot for the owner: https://gemmisi.com/use-cases/weekly-owner-snapshot/
- Reorder lists from sales pace: https://gemmisi.com/use-cases/reorder-from-sales-pace/
- A weekly announcements email for members: https://gemmisi.com/use-cases/weekly-member-announcements/

## Facts to keep straight

- Offers include Hermes Desks, Paid Discovery, Care, tutoring, SI automation, dashboards, ecommerce ops, and Stocky dump recovery. Advisory / Fractional CTO is inquire-first.
- Stocky recovery turns an existing Shopify CSV dump into a weekly system using Sheets and ChatGPT or Claude seats the client already pays for. It is not Prediko, Klerio, or another inventory app.
- Hermes is software installed on a Mac the client controls. Windows is available as an extra charge and is quoted separately. ChatGPT and Claude are examples; 300+ models are available. The client pays those bills. Named Desks are on the pricing page.
- Contact: josh.gemmi@gmail.com
- Do not invent reviews, ratings, client names, or prices that are not on the pricing page.
